visual_information.fact: what a Greenland shark looks like
scientists sampling the lens in a lab
a reveal: something hidden coming into view
uncertainty: the shark only half visible
its huge body, grown very slowly
the parasite attached to the eye

shots.narration: Scientists dated this shark to three hundred and ninety two years old.
shots.goal: One old, heavily scarred shark gliding out of the dark.
shots.action: The shark glides toward the camera out of the darkness, scars on its skin catching the lamp light
shots.composition: head and front half of the body in the upper two-thirds
edit_notes: Hook overlay: THIS SHARK / IS ALMOST / 400 YEARS OLD.

shots.goal: The whole animal, side-on, so its shape is recognisable.
shots.action: The shark swims past the camera from left to right, its full body visible
shots.composition: full body across the middle of the frame
must_show: small dorsal fins set far back

shots.narration: And that number came from its eye.
shots.action: The eye stays centred as the shark drifts slowly, the skin around it wrinkling
shots.composition: eye centred in the upper half
must_show: the shark's eye filling much of the frame

shots.narration: The lens never changes after birth.
shots.goal: The removed lens: a clear hard sphere in a dish.
shots.action: Light passes through the still lens, showing its clear layered inside
shots.composition: lens centred in the upper half of the dish
must_show: a clear glass-like sphere in a dish

shots.goal: Gloved hands cutting into the lens under a microscope.
shots.action: Fine tweezers hold the lens while a scalpel slices it to expose the dense core
shots.composition: lens centred, tools entering from the top edge
accuracy_notes: Dating used the lens nucleus, laid down before birth

shots.narration: But here is the part nobody repeats.
shots.goal: The shark emerging from total darkness: something hidden being revealed.
shots.action: The shark's head slowly emerges from black water into the edge of the lamp light
shots.composition: head entering from the lower left toward the centre
must_show: the shark's head emerging from darkness

shots.narration: The real range was two hundred and seventy two, to five hundred and twelve.
shots.goal: A calm shot of the shark that leaves space for the range overlay.
shots.action: The shark swims slowly across the lower half of the frame
shots.composition: shark in the lower third, open dark water above for the overlay
must_show: the shark in the lower third
edit_notes: Overlay a range bar 272 -> 512 with 392 marked; never generated

shots.narration: We do not know how old it is, within two hundred and forty years.
shots.goal: The shark only half visible, fading in and out of the light.
shots.action: The shark drifts at the edge of the lamp light, half its body lost in shadow
shots.composition: shark split by the edge of the light

shots.narration: It grows less than a centimetre a year,
shots.goal: The sheer length of the body, revealed slowly.
shots.action: The camera travels along the flank from head to tail
shots.composition: the flank filling the frame side to side
must_show: a long stretch of scarred flank

shots.narration: and swims slower than you walk.
shots.goal: Almost no motion: the shark barely moving while particles drift past.
shots.action: The shark creeps forward with slow tail strokes while marine snow drifts past it
shots.composition: shark across the middle, particles throughout

shots.narration: And nearly all of them are going blind.
shots.goal: The eye now pale and clouded.
shots.action: The clouded eye stays still as the shark drifts
shots.composition: eye centred in the upper half

shots.narration: A parasite clamps onto the eye, and feeds on it.
shots.goal: The parasite hanging from the eye, moving in the current.
shots.action: The ribbon-like parasite sways in the current, attached to the eye surface
shots.composition: parasite hanging down from the eye at the centre
must_show: a pale ribbon-like parasite attached to the eye
must_avoid: worms crawling out of the eye

shots.narration: It will keep going for another century.
shots.goal: The shark swimming on and away.
shots.action: The shark turns and swims away from the camera
shots.composition: shark moving from the centre toward the top of the frame

shots.narration: Blind, in the cold, two thousand metres down.
shots.goal: A tiny shape far below in deep, cold, dark water.
shots.action: The camera tilts down toward a small shape moving over the muddy seafloor far below
shots.composition: the shark small in the lower-middle of the frame, seafloor below
must_show: the shark small and far away
